title: The Jungle Front
summary: Óbidos and the lower Amazon, 2780. The army's jungle column breaks the swarm's nests on the river, Valadares leading it, Father Inácio's balloon above.

labels.fresh: FRESH: the swarm first. Its nests are young below the Barra.
labels.grown: GROWN: the city first. A year on, the swarm has spread down the rivers.

sides.name: The Jungle Column
sides.about: Valadares and the army's jungle column at Óbidos: the line, the riders, two guns and Father Inácio's balloon; the fort's garrison.

sides.name: The Swarm
sides.about: The Brood rooted on the lower Amazon: forward Mothers on the banks and the creeks, and what they lay.

objectives.text: The Fort of Óbidos must stand.
THE UPRIVER BATTERY: when the Barra fell, the swarm came down as far as Óbidos' outwork west of the fort. Retake it: kill every creature on the little rise west of the gate ({bat_left} left).
objectives.phone: Retake the upriver battery west of the gate: {bat_left} left.

objectives.text: THE FOG ON THE RIVER: under the canopy the forest is dark, and whatever is in it stays hidden. Send Father Inácio's balloon west over the water to the island (select it, right-click there) and keep it there while he looks: from up there he sees where they root.
objectives.phone: Fly Father Inácio's balloon west to the island.

objectives.text: Hold Óbidos meanwhile: creatures come out of the forest at the west gate. The Barracks and the Foundry in the fort are the column's: train there.

THE NESTS: break every forward Mother rooted on the river ({fwd_killed} of {fwd_n}). While one stands, what she lays comes down the levee to Óbidos. The balloon spots for the guns: they fire as far as it sees.
UPRIVER: Father Inácio saw only so far. More of them root up the west creek and on the upriver bank, still under the fog: fly the balloon west to find them.
The rains come back in {clock:nests}: then the flood carries what the nests lay down to the river towns.
THE ISLAND: cross the shallows to Lindqvist's old island and break the swarm's oldest ground on the fazenda's ruins: the old mound and its Rootmaws ({isl_left} left).
objectives.phone: Break the old ground on the island: {isl_left} left.

objectives.text: THE LAST WAVE: it comes down the levee from upriver, to the island and to Óbidos. Break it, or hold until it ebbs.
Bring the swarm's forward Mothers down to one before the dry season ({clock:dry}).
HOLD THE RIVER: keep at least two of your forward Mothers alive until the dry season ({fwd_left} alive). Lay at them; GROW one and lay a Mist Toad, and cover them with FOG when the guns come.
objectives.phone: Keep two forward Mothers alive: {fwd_left} alive.

objectives.text: OR BREAK ÓBIDOS: break the fort's keep on the bluff over the narrows. Brutes break palisades.
The dry season in {clock:dry}: the river falls and the column must go home.

k_open1.text: The army split at the São Francisco. One column went up the rivers, and Valadares led it.

k_fresh.text: We went north first. The swarm was young on the lower river then.

k_grown.text: We went north last. The swarm had a year on the rivers without us.

r_order.text: Valadares, you know the rivers. Take the column to Óbidos and break their nests before the rains.

r_inacio.text: And take the priest with the balloon. He swears he can see the whole river from up there.

v_open1.text: Óbidos, on the narrows of the Amazon, 2780. The fog lay on the water every morning.

v_open2.text: I had walked those banks for ten years. I could not see a thing under that canopy.

k_open_s.text: Valadares wrote this down as it happened. Here is how it would have gone if the river had been theirs.

n_open_s.text: The lower Amazon. Forward Mothers rooted on the banks and up the creeks; a column of the Crown at Óbidos.

v_1.text: The forest is dark under the canopy. Whatever roots in it, we will not see it from the ground.

i_1.text: Then let me go up, Senhor Valadares. The sky over a river is the clearest map God ever drew.

n_lesson.text: Father Inácio's balloon is yours. Select it and send it west over the water to the island: what it flies over is mapped, and the creatures there can be seen.

n_lesson2.text: Keep the line at the west gate meanwhile. The Barracks and the Foundry in the fort train for the column.

v_map.text: I know their road down from the plateau: the east creek. That much I have drawn already.

v_sealed.text: My map of the plateau is under seal in Rome. I know nothing of their road that the priest cannot see.

v_barra_burned.text: The Barra's lower town burned two years ago. We rebuilt it on the bluff. I think of it every time I see a roof.

c_gate.text: Senhor! Something moving in the trees west of the gate. We cannot see what.

n_raid.text: Creatures come out of the forest at Óbidos' west gate.

v_raid.text: Line, at the gate. Let them come into the open.

i_up.text: Up we go! Mind the rope, my sons, it is the only one I have.

i_look.text: Hold her here a little, the wind is kind. I am counting.

n_defend.text: The Mother lays as the column comes: young ones out of the swamp round her.

i_high.text: Higher than the herons now. The fog is under me like milk in a bowl.

s_bat.text: Senhor Valadares! Those of us who got out of the Barra. They are on the old battery, west of the gate. They came down after us.

v_bat.text: Then we take it back before anything else. The guns there cover the levee.

n_bat_done.text: The upriver battery is the Crown's again. The Barra's survivors come out of the fort to man it.

i_see1.text: There! I see the river from the narrows to the bend. The island in the middle, and a ruin on it.

i_see2.text: On the banks, where the ground is dry, the green has gone bare in rings. Something great lies in each ring.

i_see3.text: I count them for you, Senhor. Mark them on your map, and God keep the men who go in under those trees.

v_see.text: Forward Mothers, rooted where the bank is dry. Every one of them is a wave at our gate.

n_lift_late.text: A canoe comes down from the creeks with word of where they root. The column has it now, if not from above.

n_nests.text: Break each forward Mother. While one stands, what she lays comes down the levee. The rains come back before long.

v_nests.text: Riders to the near one on the bank. The guns behind them, under the priest.

i_west.text: There is more up the west creek, Senhor, and on the upriver bank. I cannot see through it from here.

n_west_seen.text: From over the west creek the priest sees two more rings on the bank.

n_wave.text: A wave comes down the levee to the west gate.

c_gate2.text: At the gate again, Senhor! Canister!

n_fwd_dead.text: A forward Mother is broken. Her ground stops creeping, and her waves stop.

n_toad_fog.text: A Mist Toad by the nest lays a fog bank: shots into it miss half the time. Go in with bayonets, or wait for it to thin.

v_fog.text: Fog out of a toad's throat. I have seen everything now.

v_lure.text: I used the old lure once, at the Barra. God forgive me, I kept the recipe. Once more, under our guns.

n_lured.text: The wave turns off the levee toward the lure post, into the open ground under the guns.

n_broken_all.text: Every forward Mother on this river is broken.

n_flood.text: With the rains the nests still rooted send everything they have laid down the levee at once: THE FLOOD comes at Óbidos.

n_pay.text: A boat from Ruggieri's army comes down to Óbidos' landing with the column's pay and powder: train at the Barracks and the Foundry.

n_rains.text: The rains come back. The nests still rooted will send their young down with the flood.

v_island.text: Lindqvist's island. Their oldest ground is on the ruins of his house. Over the shallows, and burn it.

n_island.text: Cross either shallows to the island. The old mound and its Rootmaws sit on the fazenda's ruins.

i_ruins.text: I see the ruin plainly now. The ground round it is the colour of a bruise.

n_isl_done.text: The old mound is broken. The ruins burn, and the ground round them goes grey.

i_last.text: Senhor! Up the levee, out of the west: more than I can count. Coming down to the island and to the town both.

n_last.text: The last wave comes down the levee from upriver. Break it, or hold until it ebbs.

c_last.text: We hold the gate, Senhor! Mind the island!

n_smell.text: More come down the levee to the place where the lure was set. They follow the smell of it.

n_ebb.text: The last wave ebbs. What is left of it goes back up the levee into the fog.

v_won.text: Ring the bell in Óbidos. Then count the men.

i_won.text: From up here the river is quiet. I will say Mass for them all on the island, if you let me land.

v_hurt.text: I am hit. It is the arm, it will do. Hold the gate.

i_hurt.text: They have torn the silk! I am coming down, Senhor, slowly, I hope.

n_keep_lost.text: The Fort of Óbidos is broken. The narrows are the swarm's.

n_s1.text: Your forward Mothers are rooted on the river's banks and up the creeks. Lay at them; your grubs make Rootmaws on their swamp for food.

n_s2.text: The Mother at the creek mouth is grown to her third stage, the Venom Sire rooted by her: she can lay Mist Toads. Research FOG on the Sire's card.

n_s_col.text: The column comes out of Óbidos with its guns, the balloon over it.

n_s_reinf.text: Boats come up from downriver: more men for Óbidos.

n_s_probe.text: Riders come out of Óbidos to look at the nearest nest.

n_s_mother.text: One of your forward Mothers is broken.

n_s_won.text: The dry season comes and the river falls. The column goes home, and the swarm is still rooted on the river.

n_s_keep.text: The Fort of Óbidos is broken. The narrows are the swarm's.

n_s_lost.text: Only one forward Mother is left on the river. The column has broken the nests.

v_end1.text: We broke their ground on the island and burned the ruin over it. Father Inácio said Mass there.

v_end1b.text: We did not reach the island in time. Their old ground is still there, under the ruin.

v_end_held.text: Every nest on the river was broken before the rains. The towns below Óbidos had a quiet year.

v_end_thin.text: Some of the nests outlived the rains. We held Óbidos; the river above it we only watched.

v_end_inacio.text: The priest stayed with the army. The men made him their chaplain, and he flew that patched balloon over every camp we made.

k_end1.text: That was the jungle front. Valadares held the river, and a priest in a basket showed him where.

k_end2.text: The Queen was never on that map. She was further up, beyond anything we had drawn.

k_end_s.text: That is not how it went. Valadares broke their nests on the river. But I have kept this page.

n_end_s.text: The column went home with the dry season. The swarm stayed rooted on the lower river.

new_balloon.text: NEW: THE OBSERVATION BALLOON. Father Inácio's: it flies over the forest and sees 14 tiles round it, so your Field Cannons can fire as far as they reach at what it sees. Here the land under the canopy stays dark until a balloon has flown over it. The Foundry at Óbidos builds more; it can also carry four men over the flood.

new_mist_toad.text: NEW: THE MIST TOAD. Laid by a Mother grown to her third stage with the Venom Sire rooted beside her: a slow swamp caster. Its TONGUE drags one enemy to its feet; its spells need research.

new_nb_fog.text: NEW: FOG BANK. Research it on the Venom Sire's card: a Mist Toad lays a fog bank where shots fired from or into it miss half the time. Lay it over your Mothers when the guns come.

new_nb_miasma.text: NEW: MIASMA. Research it on the Venom Sire's card: a Mist Toad lays a green cloud in which the Brood heal. Lay it where your creatures fight.

rome.caption: Rome, the present. The King with the mapmaker's report.

obidos.caption: Óbidos on the narrows of the Amazon, 2780: the fog on the water.

balloon.caption: Father Inácio's balloon over the canopy.

text: Óbidos on the lower Amazon, 2780. You are Valadares and the army's jungle column: the line, the riders, two guns, a Powder Wagon and Father Inácio's balloon. Óbidos' garrison holds the fort.

The forest is dark under the fog: send the balloon over the river to find the swarm's forward Mothers, then break each one before the rains. Last, cross to Lindqvist's old island and burn their oldest ground.
The Fort of Óbidos must stand.
The lower Amazon, 2780. You are the swarm: forward Mothers rooted on the banks and up the creeks, and what they lay.
A column of the Crown comes out of Óbidos with guns and a balloon. Keep two of your Mothers alive until the dry season, or break the fort's keep.

text_if.text: Every nest was broken before the rains.
The swarm's oldest ground on the island was burned.

swarm.title: The River Stays Green
swarm.text: {fwd_left} forward Mothers still rooted on the river.
